posts.title: NINE YEARS. ERASED IN A WEEK.
posts.caption: 🔥 NINE YEARS. ERASED IN A WEEK. Let me tell you who I was when this started. Nine years I substituted across Merced Union High School District, showing up, doing the work, knowing every school. I was in school myself, interning as a counselor at Buhach Colony, building the career I trained for. I was not tenured. Subs do not get that shield. But do not confuse that with having no rights. Nine years of service is a fact of record, even when the employer acts like it never happened.

posts.title: Thanksgiving Storm Knocks Out Power for 750,000+
posts.caption: 750,000 Americans are in the dark on Thanksgiving. Virginia 174K, Maryland 172K, Pennsylvania 169K, Missouri 117K, New Jersey 91K. The Macy's Parade was postponed for the first time in 100 years. Grids fail because the people who check the numbers get fired or ignored. I was fired for looking at the numbers. Here is what happens when oversight dies. What if it did affect you? What if I make it affect you?
